root_goal: Evidence-complete pre-implementation research for RICON on Arma Reforger

q_000.text: Does the combined evidence justify beginning implementation under the approved constraints?

q_001.text: Are product scope, source-of-truth artifacts, versions, and prohibited actions complete and internally consistent?

q_002.text: Which built-in VoN delivery and radio controls are exposed, authoritative, and mod-accessible?

q_003.text: Can a normal Workshop mod dynamically bind RICON per-link quality to audible VoN effects?

q_004.text: What do RelayTransceiver and IntercomTransceiver actually do, and can they satisfy leak-free radio-network relay semantics?

q_005.text: What replication, JIP, streaming, authority, and lifecycle primitives constrain the server-authoritative design?

q_006.text: What is the supported no-Play Workbench addon structure, compilation workflow, and source/resource visibility?

q_007.text: What official Workshop, BattlEye, EULA, licensing, security, and reverse-engineering boundaries apply?

q_008.text: Which HDSP formulas and calibration claims have primary-source provenance and sufficient validation evidence?

q_009.text: What architecture and budgets can plausibly support 30-player acceptance and 60-player stress?

q_010.text: Are the common core contracts and extension registries sufficient for radio, infrastructure, and later cellular use without core rewrites?

q_011.text: Which offline, compile, runtime, audio, and multi-client checks are possible with one PC, and what remains blocked?

q_012.text: Are M3a subscriber, attach, SMS, service-code, and M3b voice/handover semantics complete, private, bounded, and testable?

q_013.text: What can be learned from TFAR, ACRE2, Coalition VON, and Lima Charlie without copying incompatible or unlicensed code?

q_014.text: Are packaging, versioning, update compatibility, rollback, observability, and operational support requirements complete?

q_015.text: Do the independent Claude and Codex research corpora cover every plan section with adequate source quality and no unresolved contradiction?
